summary: Batch tool: point it at a folder of images and it mattes each background transparent.
overview: Takes a folder of images, removes a roughly solid background from each, and writes the results to an output folder. No assumptions about what the images are — copy the folder into any project that needs "remove the background from a batch of scans or photos" and it works standalone.
useCases: Cleaning up scanned or photographed art before it becomes sprites.
Stripping a flat backdrop from a batch of product or prop renders.
Preparing reference images where a solid background would show as a box in-game.

gotchas.title: It expects a roughly SOLID background
gotchas.body: The matte is a colour-similarity decision, so a textured, gradient or busy background will not come out cleanly. Check a couple of results before running a large batch.

gotchas.title: It writes to a separate output folder
gotchas.body: Originals are not modified, which is deliberate — but it also means a re-run appends to the output rather than updating in place.
